title: Decision Transformer: Reinforcement Learning via Sequence Modeling

methods.one_paragraph_description: Decision Transformer casts offline RL as conditional sequence modeling: a causal GPT transformer is fed the last K timesteps of (return-to-go, state, action) tokens with learned linear embeddings per modality plus a learned per-timestep positional embedding, and is trained with a supervised loss to predict actions. At test time the model is prompted with a desired target return; after each step the target return is decremented by the achieved reward and the process repeats until episode termination.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: sequence modeling / return-conditioned behavior cloning; paper contrasts itself with 'conventional RL algorithms' and 'TD learning' (line 24-26: 'Unlike prior approaches to RL that fit value functions or compute policy gradients, Decision Transformer simply outputs the optimal actions by leveraging a causally masked Transformer').
